proof: `DEBT REPAYMENT SCHEDULE JUNE 30, 2015`, PDF pages 42-43 of the FY2015 annual town report -- ONE table across two pages, 16 debt issues against 32 fiscal years FY2016-FY2047 plus a TOTAL column. THE PAGES ARE MIRRORED AND ROTATED IN THEIR OWN TEXT LAYER, like page 34: the words read backwards and what scans as a row at constant `top` is a COLUMN, so every word is reversed and the table is transposed before anything is read. No recognition is involved. THE YEAR COLUMNS ARE NAMED FROM THE PRINTED HEADER, NOT INFERRED: each `top` band carries its own four-digit year label, read and checked -- page 42 runs FY2032 at top=42 down to FY2016 at top=581, page 43 carries TOTAL at top=41 and FY2047 at 80 down to FY2033 at 573. Increasing `top` is right-to-left on the printed page. THE ROW GRID IS THE PAGE'S OWN ROW LABELS: every row prints PRINCIPAL, INTEREST or TOTAL, which gives 51 row anchors on each page -- 16 issues x 3 rows, plus GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL, GRAND TOTAL INTEREST and TOTAL DEBT -- and the two pages carry the same 16 issues in the same order, matched by name. THIS FILE IS THE THREE PRINTED GRAND TOTAL ROWS, one row per fiscal year, exactly as the page prints them. Each year closes on its own: grand total principal plus grand total interest is total debt, 32 of 32 years, to the dollar. WHAT DOES NOT CLOSE IS THE DOCUMENT, and all three columns are attested rather than tolerated: the 32 printed years of GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL add to $19,951,201 against the $49,556,201 the same row prints in its TOTAL cell, and the $29,605,000 between them is EXACTLY the two MS-HS CONSTRUCTION issues -- and exactly the `Schools` figure page 41 prints outside the general debt limit. The interest row is short $17,755,661 against those issues' printed interest totals of $5,195,300 and $12,560,362, a dollar apart because of the same $5 the detail file attests. THE DOCUMENT'S OWN GRAND TOTAL ROWS ARE INTERNALLY INCONSISTENT, AND THIS IS THE FINDING OF THE PAGE. In every one of the thirty year columns where they pay, the two MS-HS CONSTRUCTION issues ($9,000,000 and $20,605,000) are EXCLUDED from GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL, GRAND TOTAL INTEREST and TOTAL DEBT -- the printed FY2033 grand total principal is $82,050, which is exactly MUNICIPAL PURPOSE SEWER $49,018 plus MUNICIPAL PURPOSE WATER $33,032 and leaves out MS-HS $320,000 and $730,000 printed two rows above it. The TOTAL column of those same three rows DOES include them: $49,556,201 of principal is the sum of all sixteen issues, and page 41's `Total Long-Term Indebtedness` for 2015 prints $49,556,203 with $29,605,000 of Schools debt outside the general debt limit, which is the two MS-HS issues together. THIS WAS CHECKED BY EYE, NOT INFERRED: page 43 was rendered and looked at, and the grand total rows are printed in blue beneath the MS-HS blocks with those columns visibly blank of them. WHAT FOLLOWS FOR A READER: the town's published per-year forward debt service for FY2016 onward understates the town's own total by the school construction debt, which is $29.6M of the $49.6M outstanding. The per-ISSUE rows are complete and are what should be used.
